judge.note: Judge labels are derivative, not human gold. Probable rubric/source conflicts are separately flagged for human review.

arms_before_hybrid_design.p0: strict coding vocabulary without legal handles
arms_before_hybrid_design.d1: coding vocabulary with verified legal handles

arms_before_hybrid_design.upstream: pinned Will Chen Mike whole-document retrieval plus Ctrl+F and upstream generate_docx

execution_order.rule: Run one cell at a time to avoid workstation contention. The rotation prevents one arm from always benefiting from temporal order. Preserve failed cells; do not substitute tasks or reorder after seeing scores.

upstream_isolation.renderer_deviation: The model receives the pinned upstream structured generate_docx schema. The anonymous LAB adapter converts its sections deterministically to the current local DOCX renderer so outputs can be harvested without cloud storage. This deviation is recorded and is not a retrieval affordance.
